page.overview:
Who is Costin IV?

Emperor Costin IV was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1969–1977 AG and 1984–1988 AG) during the Era of the Princes, succeeding Audrii III as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. Costin was a grandson of Emperor Irulon I.

Costin was succeeded in 1977 by Menemtahe IV. Menemtahe was deposed in 1984 and Costin was restored to the throne, ruling until 1988, when Menemtahe was restored to the throne.

Costin had at least two children: the later emperors Costin V and Sidir VIII.
